item.title: Album Review: Coastal Conjurings on Derek Hunter Wilson’s Sculptures
item.description: Lindsay Costello by Lindsay Costello The cover of Portland composer Derek Hunter Wilson’s new album, Sculptures, finds gentle interplay between built and natural worlds. Brushy ferns and evergreens peek through an opening in moss-flecked concrete structures—nature is framed and partially obscured, a snapshot in time. item.description: by Anonymous So first, I would notice bluejays hop around my yard after the grass got mowed.
